name: Dialogue OS
install: if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else bash repos/dialogue-os/.cursor/install.sh; fi

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: for d in ../yta-assistant-travel-memory repos/yta-assistant-travel-memory /agent/repos/yta-assistant-travel-memory; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ] || ! .venv/bin/python -c "import fastapi" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'provisioning backend venv...'; rm -rf .venv && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi; [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; . .venv/bin/activate && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: YTA-ASSISTANT FastAPI backend on http://localhost:8000 (self-provisions its Python venv if missing, then serves health/memory/flights/hotels/cars).

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: for d in ../your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f repos/your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f /agent/repos/your-travel-agent-ccb6b77f; do [ -d "$d" ] && cd "$d" && break; done; [ -x node_modules/.bin/vite ] || npm ci || npm install; exec npm run dev
terminals.description: Your Travel Agent Vite/React dev server on http://localhost:8080 (installs node_modules if missing).
